title: Lec 49 Attention Part2
channel: NPTEL - Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru
description: Attention Computation, Scaled Dot-Product, Matrix Formulation, and Universal Approximation

topics.title: Scaled Dot-Product Alignment & The Softmax Simplex
topics.summary: Prof. Prathosh derives the single-token attention vector, computes inner products between query q_i and all keys K, formalizes variance scaling by sqrt(D_k) to prevent softmax saturation, and projects raw scores onto the probability simplex via softmax.

topics.title: Full Matrix Attention & Dimensionality Flow
topics.summary: Generalizes token-level attention to the canonical matrix equation Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(D_k)) V, tracking exact tensor dimensions and framing the attention block as a non-linear global sequence projector mapping R^{T x D} to R^{T x D_v}.

topics.title: Architectural Inquiry: Why Three Projections, Self-Attention & Values
topics.summary: Addresses fundamental questions on architectural design: why three projections (Q, K, V) rather than two or five, why self-attention includes token self-alignment, why attention weights alpha cannot replace value vectors, and why attention eliminates vanishing gradients.

topics.title: Complexity, Universal Approximation & The Role of Post-Attention MLPs
topics.summary: Analyzes the O(T^2) computational complexity and context window padding in practical implementations, introduces KV caching and FlashAttention, and proves why linear attention mixtures require subsequent position-wise MLPs to achieve universal function approximation.
